versions.changelog: v2.1.0: Added 3 new MCP tools (list_leave_types, list_all_leave_balances, list_payslips) — now 24 total. Fixed base URL port (8080→80). Added API key setup instructions. Fixed scenario accuracy (morning briefing, leave management, payroll review). Added role restriction docs. Added flight risk data freshness caveat.

v2.0.0: MCP-first architecture. Removed raw API endpoint docs (MCP Server handles tool discovery). Added 8 workflow scenarios (morning briefing, leave management, payroll review, flight risk, employee lookup, compliance, org structure, end-of-day summary). Skill now focuses on intelligence layer while MCP provides data layer.
